svg.title: Positive and negative parts: panel 1
svg.desc: For f(x)=sin x on [-pi,pi], f-positive keeps the positive right lobe. f-negative reflects the negative left lobe above zero. Both parts are nonnegative; subtracting them gives f and adding them gives absolute f. Dashed gray curves show the original f for comparison.
